steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.

steps.title: Sauté the garlic
steps.instruction: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.instruction: Pour in the heavy cream and let it simmer gently, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Add the parmesan
steps.instruction: Whisk in the parmesan cheese until the sauce turns smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Combine and season
steps.instruction: Drain the pasta and toss it in the sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.instruction: Top with fresh parsley and extra parmesan, then serve immediately.
